name: rft
description: Reasoning Flow Tree: keep a research project's experiments and ideas as an Obsidian-compatible tree of notes, shown live as an interactive tree in the browser and an outline pane.

autoOpen.title: Open the tree pane at session start
autoOpen.description: Open the outline pane at session start in projects where RFT is active (only where the surface docks it as a sidebar; not on the desktop app, which shows the tree view in its browser pane).
